prompt: Inside an old library, tall oak bookshelves line every wall, each shelf brimming with dusty tomes and leather-bound journals. At a central reading desk, an antique lamp casts warm light over an open book and a pair of reading glasses. A leather armchair sits beside a wooden ladder that leans against a high shelf, while a brass globe and an hourglass rest on a nearby side table. An ink bottle and quill pen stand next to a rolled-up parchment map, and a porcelain teacup with steam rising from it sits atop a stack of journals. A marble bust overlooks a stained glass window, and a velvet curtain hangs beside a roaring fireplace. On the floor, a cat sleeps curled on a worn rug, and a brass clock ticks on the mantel. Near the entrance, a stack of dust-covered manuscripts lies beneath a wooden coat rack. There is no fluorescent light, no plastic chair, no modern poster, no laptop computer, and no cardboard box.
